deploy-bot: Rollout complete: v1.17.0 -> prod-usw2 (canary 6% -> staged). Rollout ID rl_q1x7. Runbook: ops.redwood/runbooks/postdeploy-smoke.

lucy: Noticed synth alert on classify-route: short error tail (502s) for a tiny shard of long documents (~0.4% traffic). p95 up but p50 normal.

raj: Can you post sample smoke command and result?

lucy: Running the usual long-payload smoke:
```bash
PAYLOAD=$(python -c "print('X'*900)")
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/classify-route/smoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d "{\"text\": \"$PAYLOAD\"}" -w "TIME:%{time_total}s STATUS:%{http_code}" -o /dev/null
```

lucy: Result before mitigation: TIME:2.05s STATUS:502

ops: 502s on long docs only suggests heavy-tail resource pressure or a tokenizer/compat issue. Options: full rollback, route-pin for long docs, or quarantine that route from canary while investigating. Prefer minimizing blast radius.

qa: If we quarantine the route from canary, other routes keep rolling. Quarantine = set route canary weight=0% but leave global rollout. We can also add a conditional rule to route tokens>800 to previous model for 45m.

model-ops: Quick triage on logs shows worker exit codes consistent with a short-lived OOM on classify-v3 for sequences >800. We'll need mem profile, but immediate mitigation required.

ops: Agreed. Apply conditional rule to fallback long payloads to classify-v2 for 45m. Command:
```bash
redwoodctl route rule add --route classify-route --match "tokens>800" --model redwood-classify-v2 --duration 45m --reason "postdeploy 502s on long payloads"
```

deploy-bot: Action requested.

ops: Executing now.

deploy-bot: Rule applied: classify-route tokens>800 -> redwood-classify-v2 for 45m by ops. Audit ID: aud_q7b2.

qa: Rerunning smoke after rule:
```bash
PAYLOAD=$(python -c "print('X'*900)")
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/classify-route/smoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d "{\"text\": \"$PAYLOAD\"}" -w "TIME:%{time_total}s STATUS:%{http_code}" -o /dev/null
```

qa: Post-rule smoke: TIME:0.58s STATUS:200. Sample looks good.

model-ops: Uploading mem traces + crash logs to rollout artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/rl_q1x7/classify-memtrace.tar.gz. Early signal: v3 alloc spike under long tokenization. We'll reproduce in staging and run stress tests.

raj: Plan: keep rule for 45m, run repro/stress in staging and a focused warmup for v3. If warmup stabilizes (no OOMs for 10m under load), we'll reintroduce long-doc traffic at 1% then step up with 15m observation windows. If OOM persists, prepare hotfix or rollback of v3.

sre-oncall: Pager policy: suppress p95 noise for this rollout window; immediate page if 5xx > 0.5% or sustained error-rate delta > 1%. I'll monitor infra metrics and worker restarts.

lucy: Adding short note to release artifacts and changelog: "classify-route tokens>800 routed to v2 for 45m due to postdeploy long-payload 502s; memtrace attached."

ops: Reminder: conditional rules auto-expire. Extend if investigation needs more time.

model-ops: I'll post staging repro results in ~12m.

lucy: Closing thread if no further anomalies in 40m.
